 English:
"The cell damage can be from an infection by certain viruses, from a physical source such as UV damage, from a chemical source such as benzene, or by a genetic defect that occurred during the rapid replication of fetal development."

Chinese:
"细胞损伤可能由某些病毒感染引起，也可能由紫外线损伤等物理因素、苯等化学物质或胎儿发育过程中快速复制导致的基因缺陷引起。"

 English:
"Once the cell is off track, multiple mutations begin to build up, including aneuploidy and structural errors. Aneuploidy means that a cell has an abnormal number of chromosomes. Structural errors occur when part of a chromosome is missing or not in its correct position."

Chinese:
"一旦细胞发生变化，就会积累多种突变，包括非整倍性和结构错误。非整倍性是指细胞具有异常数量的染色体。结构错误是指染色体的一部分缺失或不在正确的位置。"

 English:
"Pathologists and geneticists stain and view a cell’s metaphase chromosomes using a light microscope. The stain used to help visualize the chromosomes causes a very specific banding pattern on the chromosome. Any structural changes or additional chromosomes are easily seen using this technique called karyotyping."

Chinese:
"病理学家和遗传学家使用光学显微镜对细胞的中期染色体进行染色和观察。用于帮助观察染色体的染料会在染色体上产生非常特定的带状图案。使用这种称为核型分析的技术，可以轻松观察到任何结构变化或额外的染色体。"

 English:
"A typical cell will have 46 chromosomes; any more or less is aneuploidy. If there is a large structural change or error in the chromosome, the banding pattern is altered."

Chinese:
"典型的细胞会有46条染色体；多于或少于这个数字都属于非整倍性。如果染色体发生大的结构变化或错误，带状图案就会改变。"

 English:
"There are four types of structural errors—translocations, inversions, deletions, and duplications (see Figure 1)."

Chinese:
"结构错误有四种——易位、倒位、缺失和重复（见图1）。"

 English:
"An example of a virus that causes cancer is a subtype of the human papillomavirus (HPV) known as HPV-18. HPV-18 is particularly aggressive."

Chinese:
"一种导致癌症的病毒例子是人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）的一种亚型，称为HPV-18。HPV-18尤其具有攻击性。"

 English:
"Within the virus’s 8,000 base pair DNA genome is the code for two checkpoint interfering proteins."

Chinese:
"病毒的8000个碱基对的DNA基因组中包含了两种检查点干扰蛋白的代码。"

 English:
"Like many viruses, HPV inserts itself into the chromosome of the host cell and the viral proteins are transcribed along with the host proteins."

Chinese:
"像许多病毒一样，HPV将自身插入宿主细胞的染色体中，病毒蛋白与宿主蛋白一起被转录。"

 English:
"One of the two viral proteins targets a cell division repressor molecule."

Chinese:
"这两种病毒蛋白之一针对一种细胞分裂抑制分子。"

 English:
"The first viral protein tags the repressor molecule for destruction by the cell."

Chinese:
"第一种病毒蛋白通过细胞标记抑制分子以供销毁。"

 English:
"The second viral protein acts by binding to a host protein, which traps it."

Chinese:
"第二种病毒蛋白通过与宿主蛋白结合来捕获它。"

 English:
"This particular host protein is a cell division promoter."

Chinese:
"这种特定的宿主蛋白是一种细胞分裂促进剂。"

 English:
"By residing in the promoter’s inhibition location, the virus causes the cell to move through the checkpoint and into cell division where a normal cell would have halted for repair before proceeding."

Chinese:
"通过位于促进剂的抑制位置，病毒导致细胞穿过检查点并进入细胞分裂，而正常细胞会在继续之前停止进行修复。"

 English:
"Early Cancer Detection: • Can halt progression • Increases survival odds"

Chinese:
"早期癌症检测：• 可以阻止癌症进展 • 提高生存机会"

 English:
"CAUTION SIGNS OF CANCER SEE YOUR DOCTOR"

Chinese:
"注意癌症征兆 请见医生"

 English:
"Change in bowel or bladder habits A sore that does not heal Unusual bleeding or discharge Thickening or lump Indigestion or difficulty swallowing Obvious change in wart or mole Nagging cough or hoarseness"

Chinese:
"肠道或膀胱习惯的变化 难以愈合的溃疡 不正常的出血或分泌物 增厚或肿块 消化不良或吞咽困难 明显的疣或痣变化 持续的咳嗽或声音嘶哑"

 English:
"Biopsy: surgical removal of cells for microscopic analysis Margins - outer edge of removed tissue Clear - cancer cells are not invading other tissues - Not clear - cancer cells are found throughout More tests may be required"

Chinese:
"活检：手术切除细胞进行显微镜分析 边缘 - 切除组织的外部边缘 清楚 - 癌细胞未侵入其他组织 - 不清楚 - 癌细胞遍布整个组织 可能需要进行更多测试"

 English:
"Chemotherapy causes hair loss, because hair follicles divide rapidly like cancer cells."

Chinese:
"化疗会导致脱发，因为毛囊像癌细胞一样快速分裂。"

 English:
"A. True B. False"

Chinese:
"A. 正确 B. 错误"

 English:
"Chemotherapy: chemicals that selectively kill dividing cells • Used for cancers difficult to remove surgically or spreading to new locations • Injected into the bloodstream • Combination of chemical agents – Aimed at different cell cycle events – Increased chance of destroying all cancer cells • Normal dividing cells are also damaged – Hair follicles – Cells producing red and white blood cells – Cells lining intestines and stomach"

Chinese:
"化疗：选择性杀死分裂细胞的化学物质 • 用于难以通过手术切除或扩散到新位置的癌症 • 注射到血液中 • 化学试剂的组合 – 针对不同的细胞周期事件 – 增加破坏所有癌细胞的机会 • 正常分裂的细胞也会受到损害 – 毛囊 – 产生红细胞和白细胞的细胞 – 肠道和胃壁细胞"

 English:
"Radiation therapy: use of high-energy particles to destroy cancer cells • Used after surgical removal of tumor or if surgery not possible • Usually for cancers close to the surface – Internal organs may be damaged by imprecise radiation beams • Damages DNA of remaining cancer cells"

Chinese:
"放射治疗：使用高能粒子破坏癌细胞 • 用于肿瘤手术切除后或无法手术时 • 通常用于靠近表面的癌症 – 内部器官可能会受到不精确的放射束损伤 • 损害剩余癌细胞的DNA"

 English:
"Immunotherapy: immune system selectively destroys cancer cells Targets cancer cells with specific surface marker proteins Healthy cells without marker proteins are spared Less severe effect on patient health than chemotherapy or radiation • May also be used to prevent cancer development – Vaccines boost immune system response – E.g., Human papilloma virus (HPV) exposure"

Chinese:
"免疫疗法：免疫系统选择性地破坏癌细胞 针对具有特定表面标记蛋白的癌细胞 具有标记蛋白的健康细胞得以幸免 对患者健康的影响比化疗或放射治疗轻微 • 也可用于预防癌症发展 – 疫苗增强免疫系统反应 – 例如，人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）暴露"

es: "El gen supresor de tumores está mutado. Luego produce una proteína que no es correcta, no tiene la forma adecuada y no funciona correctamente. Por lo tanto, la proteína no logra detener el tumor, como ocurre con los genes BRCA1."
fr: "Le gène suppresseur de tumeur est muté. Ensuite, il crée une protéine qui n'est pas correcte, elle n'est pas de la bonne forme, elle ne fonctionne pas correctement, par conséquent, la protéine ne parvient pas à arrêter la tumeur, les gènes BRCA1."
de: "Das Tumorsuppressor-Gen ist mutiert. Dann bildet es ein Protein, das nicht richtig ist, es ist nicht richtig geformt, es funktioniert nicht richtig. Deshalb versagt das Protein, den Tumor zu stoppen. Die BRCA1-Gene."

es: "El virus solo tiene alrededor de 8,000 pares de bases en su genoma de ADN, mientras que los humanos tienen alrededor de 3 mil millones de pares de bases."

id: "Salah satu dari dua protein virus menargetkan pembagi sel. Protein virus pertama menandai molekul represor untuk dihancurkan oleh sel."

es: "Una de las dos proteínas virales se dirige a un divisor celular. La primera proteína viral etiqueta la molécula represora para su destrucción por parte de la célula."
fr: "L'une des deux protéines virales cible un diviseur cellulaire. La première protéine virale marque la molécule de répression pour destruction par la cellule."
de: "Ein virales Protein von beiden zielt auf einen Zellteiler ab. Das erste virale Protein markiert das Repressormolekül für die Zerstörung durch die Zelle."

ja: 「2番目のウイルス性タンパク質は、宿主タンパク質に結合し、それをトラップすることで作用する。」

These checkpoints have been evolutionarily conserved, meaning the checkpoint mechanisms in fruit flies are very similar to those in our own bodies. At each of the three checkpoints the cell determines whether or not all of the components and conditions have been met for cell division to proceed. Each checkpoint involves numerous molecules interacting in a set of complex cell signaling pathways. A change to these signaling pathways can cause cell division by promoting molecules to be expressed more than usual or by hindering molecules expression. In eukaryotic cells, these checkpoints are points within cell division in which the cell can go one of three ways: cell division can be halted either temporarily or permanently; cell division can proceed; or cell death can be triggered. These checkpoints have been evolutionarily conserved, meaning the checkpoint mechanisms in fruit flies are very similar to those in our own bodies. At each of the three checkpoints the cell determines whether or not all of the components and conditions have been met for cell division to proceed. Each checkpoint involves numerous molecules interacting in a set of complex cell signaling pathways. A change to these signaling pathways can cause cell division by promoting molecules to be expressed more than usual or by hindering molecules expression. Any of these changes in a normal cell’s signaling pathways can cause the cell to replicate out of control—this is cancer.
The cell damage can be from an infection by certain viruses, from a physical source such as UV damage, from a chemical source such as benzene, or by a genetic defect that occurred during the rapid replication of fetal development.
Once the cell is off track, multiple mutations begin to build up, including aneuploidy and structural errors. Aneuploidy means that a cell has an abnormal number of chromosomes. Structural errors occur when part of a chromosome is missing or not in its correct position. Pathologists and geneticists stain and view a cell’s metaphase chromosomes using a light microscope. The stain used to help visualize the chromosomes causes a very specific banding pattern on the chromosome. Any structural changes or additional chromosomes are easily seen using this technique called karyotyping.
A typical cell will have 46 chromosomes; any more or less is aneuploidy. If there is a large structural change or error in the chromosome, the banding pattern is altered. There are four types of structural errors—translocations, inversions, deletions, and duplications (see Figure 1). Translocations arise when part of one chromosome breaks off and attaches to another chromosome. Inversions involve a section of a chromosome breaking off and then reattaching to the same chromosome upside down. A deletion is when a section of a chromosome is completely absent. Duplications occur when a section of the chromosome is repeated.
